rule.statement: Whether the land has been correctly identified shall ultimately be decided not by the surveyor, but by the Court, after considering the totality of the evidence presented before it.
rule.supporting_quote: There is no doubt that the surveyor’s answer to that question carries great weight. Nevertheless, whether the land has been correctly identified shall ultimately be decided not by the surveyor, but by the Court, after considering the totality of the evidence presented before it.
